patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Amplemarket and Bombora share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Amplemarket only if your buying job matches “AI-powered multichannel outbound platform combining lead intelligence, sequences, delivera” rather than Bombora's shape. Choose Bombora only if your buying job matches “Intent-data specialist (Company Surge®) for B2B account prioritization — not a contact dat” rather than Amplemarket's shape. Workflow advantage: Amplemarket leans sales-engagement, email-outreach; Bombora leans data-enrichment, lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Amplemarket and Bombora share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Amplemarket is AI-powered multichannel outbound platform combining lead intelligence, sequences, deliverability, and Duo AI assistants.; Bombora is Intent-data specialist (Company Surge®) for B2B account prioritization — not a contact database; custom-quote packaging..
- Workflow coverage skew: Amplemarket-leaning sales-engagement, email-outreach vs Bombora-leaning data-enrichment, lead-management.
- Researched limits: Amplemarket — Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.; Bombora — Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database.

Limitations — Amplemarket: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.; Startup already $600/mo annual; Growth/Elite are custom-quoted.; Bombora: Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database; Custom-quote only via speak-to-an-expert path.

Poor-fit cases: Amplemarket is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record. · Bombora is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database · Avoid Amplemarket if you actually need Bombora's motion (Intent-data specialist (Company Surge®) for B2B account prioritization — not a c)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
